text: I am in the WAIT camp and I ratify h1_close_above:bar_high, not reclaim:ma_20. The breakout printed on day_vol 2.72; rs_rank_pct 97.12 with W HH/HL is the leader. pct_from_pivot 5.09 is already past a few percent, so the buy is the first quiet, light-volume pullback toward the pivot, then the hourly close above the prior day's high (C5, C6). Yes, oneil's pivot_high +5pct cap belongs on it: that is my chase rule. Keep the pull-in as a light-volume pullback; a pullback on heavier volume voids it (C6).
